messages:
linda-support: Hey @matt-billing, customer Nebula Apps reports Console shows $450 promo credits on their org page but API /billing/usage returns credit_balance: 0 and usage shows no applied credits. Ticket #CS-9124. Attaching console screenshot and sample API response.

matt-billing: thanks. Can you paste the exact API call + response? Is the request using the org API key or project key?

linda-support: here's the call they ran (project key):
GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/usage?project_id=nebula-prod
Response: {
  "project_id":"nebula-prod",
  "usage_tokens": 12345,
  "applied_credits": 0,
  "credit_balance": 0
}
Console screenshot: https://redwood.internal/snapshots/CS-9124/console.png

jon-eng: quick thought — we recently changed tenant linking so org-level promos should create a project allocation record. Possible the allocation job failed to emit project-level meta. Can someone grab the metering logs for that org id?

ashley-ops: pulling logs now for org_id: org_nebula_01. I see a failed row in allocations stream around 2026-11-02T03:12:14Z with error: "FK project_id not found" for project nebula-prod. Looks like tenant-link mapping was stale.

billing-bot: automated check: promo code PROMO-RED-2026 applied to org_nebula_01 at 2026-11-01T22:05:11Z. Allocation job status: PARTIAL_FAIL. Missing allocations: project:nebula-prod

matt-billing: that aligns. So Console shows org-level balance (correct), but the per-project metering table never received the allocation row — hence API (project-scoped) reports zero. We need to re-run allocations for that org and backfill project allocation rows.

jon-eng: I can run a targeted resync for org_nebula_01. Plan: snapshot current allocations, run resync job with --force-backfill --org org_nebula_01, then verify project_allocation table has row and billing job picks it up. ETA ~30m.

sara-support: I'll update the customer: "We found the discrepancy — org promo applied but project-level allocation missed due to a linking error. We're reprocessing now and will confirm when credits show in API." Keep me posted on timeline.

ashley-ops: resync started. Command:
```
service-billing resync-allocations --org org_nebula_01 --force-backfill --idempotent
```
Logs: backfill started, created allocation row project=nebula-prod amount=45000 (cents), wrote audit entry audit_id=audit_20261102_01

billing-bot: backfill completed for org_nebula_01. Emitted events count: 1. Allocation UUID: alloc_0a9f

matt-billing: after backfill, I triggered the metering pipeline to re-run recent window for project nebula-prod. Confirmed now API response:
{
  "project_id":"nebula-prod",
  "usage_tokens":12345,
  "applied_credits":45000,
  "credit_balance":45000
}

linda-support: confirmed with customer: API now shows credits. They reported calls that previously returned charges now show 0 applied cost. Customer happy. I emailed CS-9124 update and closed the loop.

jon-eng: root cause: tenant-link table had missing mapping for nebula-prod due to a race in the tenant onboarding flow. Created issue INTERNAL-2345 to add a consistency check and to surface PARTIAL_FAIL in the Console allocations UI so customers / support can see the gap earlier.

matt-billing: follow-ups: 1) add a one-off backfill job in the billing admin UI, 2) unit test for tenant-link creation path, 3) alert rule on allocations PARTIAL_FAIL count > 0. I'll own the alert and backfill feature.

sara-support: noted. CS ticket updated and customer notified about the fix and that we've added an internal issue for the onboarding race. Marking thread as resolved from support side. :white_check_mark:
